edits.before: - Rakan Grand Entrance: matchup-defining — The leap knockup starts every play — track him in fog; the E extends it. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Curse of the Black Mist answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
